tools.name: search
tools.description: Search venues, travel destinations and places inside destinations by name or keyword. Returns results of id, title and url; pass an id to fetch for the full page. For filters use search_venues, search_menus or destination_listings.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a search result's full page: a restaurant's menu, dietary options, hours and events, or a destination's. Returns Markdown text with its citable url. Ids look like "venue:acme-bistro", "venue:acme-bistro:menu", "destination:los-cabos" or "listing:los-cabos:1234".

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Find restaurants and bars by city, cuisine, opening time or features. Filters are HARD, prefer_* and avoid are SOFT (rank only), and query is a name, a keyword or a short description. Each result has slug, capabilities, open_now and distance_km; a destination city's venues are here, its listings in

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities that have published restaurants and bars. A city can also be a travel destination, such as Los Cabos: search_venues finds its venues, and destination_overview and destination_listings read the destination's own board.

tools.name: search_menus
tools.description: Find dishes across all venues by text, city, dietary tags or allergens to avoid. Each item is tagged with its venue, so one call compares venues; for one named venue use venue_menu.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send Yenta a report: data that is missing or looks wrong, a tool that was hard to use, or anything else. Stored for Yenta's team and never shown publicly; the answer carries a reference. Leave out personal details.

tools.name: venue_profile
tools.description: Get a venue's hours, address, map, phone, booking and links by name or slug, e.g. venue="Acme Bistro". It also holds cuisine, attributes, menu_summary and capabilities (the other venue_* tools that answer for it); hours_summary is ready to quote.

tools.name: venue_menu
tools.description: Find dishes at a named venue, e.g. venue="Acme Bistro", dietary_tags=["vegan"], allergens=["milk"]. Filter by text, tags, allergens or max_price; unfiltered, item lists its dietary tags, example dishes and allergen counts. If not available, check the capabilities venue_profile lists; the venue may n

tools.name: venue_faq
tools.description: Answer a question about a named venue from its published FAQs; omit query to read them all. If not available, check the capabilities venue_profile lists; the venue may not publish this.

tools.name: venue_events
tools.description: Find what is on at a named venue: dated events from its local today onwards. Filter by exact event_type if you know it. If not available, check the capabilities venue_profile lists; the venue may not publish this.

tools.name: destination_overview
tools.description: One call answers what a destination offers and what's on: counts, a few places, next events and guide topics. It counts offers, seasonality and FAQs too, and names the categories and areas listings, events and offers filter by. preview.complete is false when destination_listings / destination_events

tools.name: destination_listings
tools.description: Find places to stay, eat and visit in a named destination by text, category, area or tags. Every query word matches, in any order; each business appears once (also_listed_as) with a snippet and map_url, so call it again with listing_id for the full text. An unknown filter value's reason lists the va

tools.name: destination_events
tools.description: Find what is on in a named destination: events from today onwards. A recurring event's dates are its series span, so read its recurrence. Results carry booking_url, the partner's booking page when present, and canonical_url, the destination's page.

tools.name: destination_guide
tools.description: Read a named destination's travel guides: weather, getting here, transport, entry requirements, safety and more. Pass topic (from destination_overview guide_topics) to read one subject; page with cursor.

tools.name: destination_faq
tools.description: Answer a question about a named destination from its published FAQs; omit query to read them all.

tools.name: destination_offers
tools.description: Find a named destination's current deals and packages, with the partner booking link. Only offers valid on valid_on (today by default), or on any day from from_date to to_date, are returned. Results carry booking_url, the partner's booking page when present, and canonical_url, the destination's page

tools.name: destination_seasonality
tools.description: Get a named destination's best time to visit, weather and wildlife seasons (e.g. whale watching), month by month.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: send_feedback, venue_menu, venue_faq, venue_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: send_feedback, venue_menu, venue_faq, venue_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
